title: TP stress suite results (perf lab) — runtime 1.18 vs 1.19 WIP
content:
Doc purpose
- Spreadsheet-style rollup of TP stress suite runs across GPU types + batch/concurrency settings.
- Primary goal: catch regressions (hangs/timeouts, p99 inflation, throughput drop) while landing TP stability fixes.

How to read
- “Hangs” here means: request(s) exceed 2x scenario timeout OR replica enters TP watchdog abort (when enabled).
- “Timeouts” are client-side request timeouts (streaming or non-streaming) in the harness.
- “Watchdog aborts” are runtime-triggered abort/drain events (feature-flagged) — can be true stall or false positive.

Test matrix (fixed knobs)
- TP size: 2 and 4 (where supported)
- Scenarios:
  S1 = Mixed prefill/decode (bursty), streaming ON
  S2 = Long context prefill (64k), short decode
  S3 = Steady-state decode-heavy (small prompts, many concurrent)
  S4 = Replica churn (drain/replace while load continues)
- Models used (serving runtime equivalents):
  M1 = 8B instruct (baseline)
  M2 = 70B instruct (high pressure)
- Duration per run: 25 min (warmup 5m + measure 20m)

Runtime builds compared
- Baseline: runtime-1.18.4 (current prod reference)
- Candidate: runtime-1.19.0-rc2 (includes scheduler guardrail + NCCL sync hardening + optional watchdog + KV compaction fix)

Environment notes
- All runs executed in benchmark-lab with fixed clocks where available.
- NCCL debug logging OFF except where explicitly noted (to avoid perturbation).
- Metrics collected: p50/p95/p99 latency (ms), output tok/s (aggregate), GPU util (%), NCCL error count, stall_reason counts (if instrumented).

============================================================
SUMMARY TABLE — PASS/FAIL BY HARDWARE + SCENARIO
(“Pass” = no hangs, no harness timeouts above threshold, no unbounded p99 creep)

| HW (GPU) | TP | Model | runtime-1.18.4 | runtime-1.19.0-rc2 | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| A100 80GB SXM | 4 | M2 (70B) | FAIL (S1, S4) | PASS (S1, S4) | Hang signature no longer reproduced; watchdog not required to pass |
| A100 80GB SXM | 4 | M2 (70B) | PASS (S2, S3) | PASS (S2, S3) | Minor throughput delta (see perf table) |
| H100 80GB SXM | 4 | M2 (70B) | PASS | PASS | Perf regression risk in S3 (decode-heavy) ~3–5% tok/s drop |
| L40S 48GB | 2 | M1 (8B) | PASS | PASS | No stability signal; use mainly for quick gating |
| A10G 24GB | 2 | M1 (8B) | PASS | PASS | Not representative for enterprise TP; included for breadth |

Overall interpretation
- Stability: Candidate build eliminates the known A100 TP hang signature in S1/S4 (mixed prefill/decode + churn) that repeatedly reproduced on 1.18.4.
- Performance: Candidate has a small decode-heavy throughput regression on H100 TP=4 (likely from extra stream/event sync). A100 impact is smaller/within noise.
- Watchdog: When enabled, it catches real stalls reliably in injected-failure runs; one borderline false-positive observed in long-context runs at extreme concurrency (details below).

============================================================
PERF TABLE — KEY METRICS (MEASURE WINDOW AVERAGES)

Table key
- p99 = end-to-end request latency p99 (ms)
- tok/s = aggregate generated output tokens per second (higher is better)
- timeouts = harness request timeouts during measurement window
- hangs = harness detected hang events (stuck requests) OR replica wedged

SCENARIO S1 — Mixed prefill/decode (bursty), streaming ON
Prompt mix: 60% short (256–1k), 30% medium (2k–8k), 10% long (16k–32k)
Decode target: 256 tokens

| Run ID | HW | TP | Model | runtime | Concurrency | Max batch (tokens) | p99 (ms) | tok/s | timeouts | hangs | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| S1-A100-01 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.18.4 | 96 | 24k | 18200 | 2850 | 41 | 2 | Repro hang signature: ranks stop advancing; no NCCL error surfaced |
| S1-A100-02 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.19.0-rc2 | 96 | 24k | 7100 | 2780 | 0 | 0 | Scheduler guardrail + ordering hardening; no stall_reason spikes |
| S1-H100-01 | H100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.18.4 | 128 | 28k | 6400 | 4120 | 0 | 0 | Baseline stable |
| S1-H100-02 | H100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.19.0-rc2 | 128 | 28k | 6600 | 3990 | 0 | 0 | Slight tok/s decrease (~3.2%), p99 within noise |

SCENARIO S2 — Long context prefill (64k), short decode
Prompt: 64k tokens prefill
Decode target: 64 tokens

| Run ID | HW | TP | Model | runtime | Concurrency | Prefill batch (req) | p99 (ms) | tok/s | timeouts | hangs | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| S2-A100-01 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.18.4 | 16 | 4 | 28900 | 920 | 0 | 0 | Stable but close to mem pressure |
| S2-A100-02 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.19.0-rc2 | 16 | 4 | 30100 | 905 | 0 | 0 | Slight perf hit (~1.6%), likely sync overhead |
| S2-H100-01 | H100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.19.0-rc2 | 24 | 6 | 21400 | 1340 | 0 | 0 | Stable |
| S2-A100-WD-01 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.19.0-rc2 (watchdog ON) | 24 | 6 | 40200 | 770 | 3 | 0 | 1 watchdog abort at t+11m; suspected false positive (no NCCL errors; GPU util dipped briefly). Needs follow-up on default thresholds for long prefill. |

SCENARIO S3 — Steady-state decode-heavy (small prompts)
Prompt: 512 tokens
Decode target: 512 tokens

| Run ID | HW | TP | Model | runtime | Concurrency | Max batch (req) | p99 (ms) | tok/s | timeouts | hangs | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| S3-H100-01 | H100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.18.4 | 192 | 24 | 5100 | 4680 | 0 | 0 | Reference |
| S3-H100-02 | H100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.19.0-rc2 | 192 | 24 | 5400 | 4460 | 0 | 0 | Regression: -4.7% tok/s; p99 +5.9% |
| S3-A100-01 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.18.4 | 144 | 20 | 6900 | 3120 | 0 | 0 | Reference |
| S3-A100-02 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.19.0-rc2 | 144 | 20 | 7100 | 3050 | 0 | 0 | Small change (-2.2% tok/s), likely acceptable if stability improved |

SCENARIO S4 — Replica churn under load (drain/replace)
Method: every 5 minutes, drain 1 replica and bring up a new one; traffic continues.

| Run ID | HW | TP | Model | runtime | Concurrency | Drain interval | p99 (ms) | tok/s | timeouts | hangs | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| S4-A100-01 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.18.4 | 96 | 5m | 24000 | 2480 | 65 | 1 | Hang manifests after 2nd drain (collective mismatch suspected) |
| S4-A100-02 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.19.0-rc2 | 96 | 5m | 9800 | 2610 | 2 | 0 | No hang; 2 timeouts coincide with drain boundary (expected) |
| S4-A100-WD-02 | A100 80GB | 4 | M2 | 1.19.0-rc2 (watchdog ON) | 96 | 5m | 10500 | 2560 | 0 | 0 | Watchdog did not trigger; healthy drain behavior |

============================================================
REGRESSION / ANOMALY LOG (NEEDS FOLLOW-UP)

1) H100 decode-heavy throughput regression (S3)
- Symptom: ~3–5% tok/s drop on H100 TP=4; p99 modestly up.
- Likely cause: NCCL stream/event sync hardening adds extra synchronization on the critical path during decode.
- Impact assessment: Might be acceptable if stability gains are required, but should try to claw back perf (conditional sync, fast-path when ordering proven safe).
- Owner: Yuki Sato + Grace Kim (kernel/comms boundary)
- Related: GitHub redwood/pr-21853 (sync hardening). See also Slack thread “perf impact of extra stream sync”.

2) Watchdog false-positive suspicion in long-context extreme concurrency (S2-A100-WD-01)
- Symptom: 1 watchdog abort; no corresponding NCCL error; GPU util dip preceded abort.
- Hypothesis: watchdog threshold too tight for certain prefill spikes + backpressure; not actually a deadlock.
- Action: collect per-rank heartbeat gap + in-flight collective counters around the event; tune thresholds by phase (prefill vs decode) and by model/context length.
- Owner: Omar El-Sayed + Rafael Mendes (SRE input on alertability)
- Related: GitHub redwood/pr-21860 (watchdog), redwood/pr-21834 (heartbeat metrics).

3) Minor drain-boundary timeouts remain (S4-A100-02)
- Symptom: 2 timeouts coincide with drain boundary.
- Interpretation: expected during churn; check if load-shed hook is enabled to reduce client-visible timeouts (redirect/reject rather than queue).
- Owner: Julian Moore
- Related: GitHub redwood/pr-21875 (load shed on TP stall signal)

============================================================
PROPOSED GATING THRESHOLDS (FOR PERF-CANARY / RELEASE)
Draft; please comment before we lock for runtime-1.19 canary.

Stability gates (hard)
- Any hang event in S1 or S4 on A100 TP=4 => FAIL
- Any NCCL error burst > 0.01 / min in any scenario => FAIL
- Watchdog abort rate > 0.1 / hr (when enabled) => FAIL (unless classified as expected injected failure)

Performance gates (soft → hard after tuning)
- Decode-heavy tok/s drop (S3) > 5% vs baseline on H100 => WARN (hard-fail if > 8%)
- p99 increase > 10% vs baseline in S3 without offsetting stability benefit => WARN

============================================================
NOTES / NEXT RUNS
- Re-run S3 on H100 with:
  (a) sync hardening toggled (if we can conditionalize) to isolate impact
  (b) NCCL debug enabled for a short window to confirm ordering remains consistent
- Re-run S2 with watchdog ON after adjusting thresholds (prefill-aware) to validate false-positive reduction.
- Expand A100 matrix to include TP=2 (some Dedicated customers run TP=2 replicas at higher replica counts).

Changelog
- 2025-02-20: initial sheet created; added baseline A100 repro data.
- 2025-02-26: added 1.19-rc2 comparisons for S1/S4; marked stability as PASS.
- 2025-03-03: added H100 decode-heavy perf table; logged throughput regression for follow-up.
